sources.title: Qwen 3.6 27B - AI Model | There's An AI For That
sources.snippet: Qwen3.6-27B is Qwen's open-weight multimodal model for coding, agent workflows, long-context reasoning, and vision-language tasks. It combines a 27B causal language model with a vision encoder, supports image-text-to-text use, and offers a native 262,144-token context window extendable to about 1.01M tokens.
